Here’s a classic set‑up for a hearty homemade lasagna—feel free to tweak it to suit your taste or dietary preferences: | Category | Typical Ingredients | |----------|---------------------| | **Lasagna Noodles** | • 9–12 sheets (regular or no‑boil) | | **Meat Sauce** | • 1 lb ground beef
• ½ lb Italian sausage (optional)
• 1 small onion, finely chopped
• 2 cloves garlic, minced
• 28 oz crushed tomatoes (or passata)
• 15 oz tomato sauce
• 1 tsp dried oregano
• 1 tsp dried basil
• Pinch red pepper flakes (if you like heat)
• Salt & black pepper to taste | | **Ricotta Layer** | • 15 oz ricotta cheese
• ¼ cup grated Parmesan
• 1 egg (helps bind)
• Fresh parsley or basil, chopped (≈1 tbsp) | | **Mozzarella Layer** | • 16 oz shredded mozzarella (part-skim works well) | | **Optional Extras** | • Sautéed spinach or kale (about 2 cups cooked, drained)
• Grated zucchini or sliced mushrooms (sautéed lightly)
• A splash of white wine added to the meat sauce for depth | ### Quick Prep Steps 1. **Cook noodles:** Boil until al dente; drain and lay flat on parchment paper so they don’t stick together. 2. **Make meat sauce:** Brown meats, add onions/garlic, then stir in tomatoes, herbs, salt, pepper, and simmer ~20 min. 3. **Mix ricotta filling:** Combine ricotta, Parmesan, egg, herbs, and seasonings. 4. **Assemble layers:** Start with a thin spread of sauce at the bottom of a baking dish, layer noodles, ricotta mixture, optional veggies, more sauce, and finish with mozzarella. 5. **Bake:** Cover with foil, bake 25 min, remove foil, bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden. Enjoy! Feel free to swap out cheeses (e.g., provolone), use whole‑wheat noodles, or make a vegetarian version using lentils instead of meat.
